addSeparator

public void addSeparator(char sep)
Add a separator to the code.

The separator is used to groups new signs ; it can be '*', '-', ' ', ':'. The exact effect depends on currentCode and on the presence of a previous separator.

if currentCode is empty and there is no current separator, the separator becomes the current separator. if there is a current separator, the current separator is used to group the last two signs before the separator, and the new separator becomes the current separator. If currentCode is not empty, add the corresponding glyph to the model, according to the current separator, and then make sep the current separator.

Parameters:
sep -

insertElement

public void insertElement(ModelElement e)
Insert a modelElement in the text. This element will be duplicated, so the base element can be considered as a prototype. This will only work on elements which can be inserted in a text, that is, elements which are not TopItemLists or modifiers.

Parameters:
e -

addPhilologicalMarkup

public boolean addPhilologicalMarkup(int type)
Adds a philological markup around the selected zone. Respects the current model's view of philological markup. If markup considered as parenthesis, it will be add so. Else, two signs will be added.

Parameters:
type - one of SymbolCodes.ERASEDSIGNS, EDITORADDITION, EDITORSUPERFLUOUS, PREVIOUSLYREADABLE or SCRIBEADDITION.
